svg.title: The reply to a discussion
svg.desc: Someone other than Dennis or a bot opens a discussion or comments on one. A discussion of Dennis, and one whose answer was chosen, end there. Otherwise the pager shows it in its topic and asks the control repository for a draft at once, which Claude writes in Dennis's voice. The draft comes with Send, Edit and Ignore. Send posts exactly that draft as the pager's app, in the thread of the comment that it answers, or on the discussion itself. A new comment of someone else makes itself the message to answer, with a new draft, in the same topic.
